name: Render resolution 1920x1080, output 1920x1080
description: Output and render resolution 1920x1080. The game's defaults are an output of 3840x2160 and a render resolution of 2560x1440; this patch sets both, so the scene, the upscale, the UI and the final composition all run at the lower size. Use only one of the three variants.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: Not tested with these exact values. The same write with output 1920x1080 and render 1280x720 gave the right picture in the KytyPS5 fork (5ff7b6da, 2026-11-14).
